Parents who choose Madiinah usually hope their child will grow to embody city, settlement and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Madiinah
in_english.meaning: City of the Prophet, illuminated city
in_english.long_meaning: Madiinah is the city where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) lived and migrated to from Mecca. It holds immense spiritual significance in Islam as the center of the Islamic state during the lifetime of the Prophet and a major pilgrimage site.

data.cultural_impact: Madiinah is a legendary city in Islamic history, famous as the second holiest city in Islam, after Makkah. It is the capital city of the province of Al Madinah Al Munawwarah in Saudi Arabia. Situated in the Hejaz region in the western part of the Arabian Peninsula, this city has been historically significant as the place where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions migrated after facing persecution in Makkah, and established a new community based on Islamic values and principles. Madinah was the first Muslim state with a formal constitution, the Constitution of Medina, which outlined the rights and responsibilities of its citizens, regardless of their race, religion or tribe. This city has been a center of learning and knowledge, preserving Islamic history, culture and heritage. Today, it is a major tourist destination, attracting millions of pilgrims and tourists from around the world every year.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic belief, Madiinah is a blessed city, a residence of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions, a place of revelation and spiritual growth. It is the city where the Prophet established the first Islamic state, implemented the divine law, and spread the message of Islam to the world. The Prophet's mosque in Madiinah is the burial place of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions, and is a major center of religious and spiritual activity for millions of Muslims around the world. The city holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims as a place of worship, learning, and reflection on the teachings of Islam, and a reminder of the Prophet's mission to bring peace and prosperity to humanity.
